title: How to follow up with your Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide leads
titleHtml: How to follow up with your Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide leads
sub: Use these scripts immediately after receiving a new Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide lead.

video.title: Funnel scripts training video
video.caption: Watch this before you start calling.

steps.title: Call them
steps.lead: They probably won't pick up, so leave this voicemail:
script: I saw you requested our free Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide featuring recipes designed to help support your hormones. I'm going to text you the link now so you have it handy.

I can also send you information about Glutathione, a wellness product that can be a great addition to your daily hormone-support routine. If you're interested, just reply back to my text. No pressure at all.

If you don't see my text, check your Unknown Senders or Spam folder. On an iPhone, look for the filter or menu icon in the top right corner of your Messages app, its usually three little lines. On an Android, look for the three-dot menu. You should be able to find any filtered messages there which is where my text to you might be.
Okay, that's all for now! Let me know if you received the text. Talk soon!

steps.title: Text them
steps.lead: As soon as you hang up, send this:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]! 👋 Just left you a quick voicemail - Here is the link to the Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide you requested so you have it handy - https://assets.cdn.filesafe.space/DS2WOWmJ3mmZ0vCsxv8H/media/80846291-63b4-45ed-8593-575603003dbf.pdf

Also - did you want to take a free look at Glutathione, a wellness product that can be a great addition to your daily hormone-support routine? If things like low energy, stubborn weight, mood changes, or just not feeling quite like yourself have been frustrating you, this may be worth checking out. Just reply INFO and I'll hook you up.

steps.title: Follow up in 24 hrs
steps.lead: If they don't respond within 24 hours, text again:
script: [Name]! Just following up on the above! 👆 Were you able to get the Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide? Want some info on the Glutathione I mentioned? Shoot me a text back - I can hook you up!

tip: Tip: Personalize [Name] and [Your Name] every time. The Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide link is already in the text script - just hit Copy script and send it as-is.
footer: Hormone Lunchbox Recipe Guide follow-up · Quick reference · Keep this handy by your phone
